requires: Both rank-result.json and fork-result.json passed in nus-peer-value-20261119-1
actor: Same unchanged original peer action weights, native D-152 action-head PPO, no behavior teacher or stat reward. The two value heads are selected on training-library validation seeds.
large_run_decision: For a recommendation, require positive paired utility with a 95% lower bound above zero versus equal-budget compact PPO, a positive point estimate versus the original peer, and no material loss in reach or common-seed T12/T14 growth and original mechanisms. Review tail bounds and sample size. A recommendation never submits an overnight job.
